payload.approved_effect: On Lappy, clone the public Signpost API repository, inspect the two placeholder translators and parity test, collapse them to one correct production implementation, update tests, and run local npm test/typecheck validation.
stop_conditions: Stop before any public issue comment, claim, fork, upstream push, pull request, terms, or payout step.
Stop if implementation requires secrets, spend, production access, destructive external testing, or nonpublic data.
Stop if fresh issue state shows the bounty closed or claimed before local preparation completes.
explicit_exclusions: No identity, tax, wallet, or payout submission.
